newsitem.title: POLAND: Polfa Kutno to pay no '96 dividend - paper.
newsitem.headline: Polfa Kutno to pay no '96 dividend - paper.

text.p: Polish drug maker Polfa Kutno SA will not pay a dividend for 1996 to help finance its 43-million-zloty investment plans for this year, the firm's deputy president told daily Parkiet in its Friday edition.
"Polfa will not pay shareholders part of net profits until the end of 1998," the paper quoted Jan Krysiuk as saying.
Krysiuk said the firm was not planning a new share issue but was considering a convertible bond or commercial paper issue sometime after 1997.
Last year Polfa Kutno netted 16.2 million zlotys on sales of 171.2 million zlotys.
